description: This file provides utility functions for normalizing and extracting error messages from various error objects within a JavaScript/React application, specifically tailored for handling errors from Supabase services and generic errors.

methods.name: normalizeError(err)
methods.description: Converts any error (Error object, string, plain object, or other) into a standardized object with a message and raw error.

methods.name: getErrorMessage(err, fallback = "Something went wrong.")
methods.description: Provides a user-facing error message string derived from an error object, with an optional fallback.
